name: Eugene
cooked: I don’t have much to add here, but I think 95b0d0f836f18d78dfbae435fb37bf6fff2e37a4fc01c20be8495bc3ea4fbb58 could be a case of a neutrino light-client with a corrupted database. For some reason, I remember there being a few database corruption issues which would make sense since the hash is not a block hash. Maybe it could be a `cfheader` hash? Are those requests all from the same peer?
